reproResult: Followed steps 1-4 literally in my own worktree at 16ceb3a54 (pnpm install + turbo build; cp script into plugins/provider-claude-code; `node repro-1654.mjs` -> exit 0 "NOT reproduced", turn 2 sends token B; `REPRO_MODE=preserve-mtime node repro-1654.mjs` -> exit 1 "BUG REPRODUCED", turn 2 still sends token A, turn 3 (new process) sends token B). Output matches the report's <pre> blocks line for line. Also re-ran both modes with REPRO_CLAUDE_BIN=~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.234 (the binary bb actually spawns): preserve-mtime still reproduces (11 calls per 429 turn), plain flow still does not (logs in /tmp/bb-reports/issues/1654/verify/my-run-*.log). Independently confirmed the bb e2e claim on my own dev instance (:26258/:34258): the same claude pid (3309075, /home/sawyer/.local/bin/claude 2.1.234) served two turns and stayed alive idle; `bb thread stop` released it and the next message spawned pid 3346377 (my-bb-e2e-pid.txt). Verified the CLI excerpts (mtime probe A8_, keychain 30 s cache / "serving stale cache", plaintext delete-only-when-keychain-empty) in `strings` of linux 2.1.234 and the darwin binaries in /tmp/bb1654-mac, the 2.1.178 changelog entry, all ten permalinks at 16ceb3a54, and that origin/main (16ceb3a54..a108fa7ef) contains no fix. Dev instance stopped and worktree left clean.

findings.section: Environment / Minimal reproduction / Related issues / excerpts §4
findings.problem: The repro's default invocation (no REPRO_CLAUDE_BIN) does not run Claude Code 2.1.234 as the report states; the Agent SDK 0.3.197 spawns its own bundled binary (@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-linux-x64 -> `claude --version` = 2.1.197). The logs run-default-2.1.234.log and run-preserve-mtime-2.1.234.log are therefore mislabeled, and the derived claim that '2.1.234 makes a single call and no longer retries usage-limit 429s in-process (1 call vs 11 in 2.1.233)' is false: the real 2.1.234 binary (which is what bb spawns via resolveClaudeCodeExecutable) retries 11 times exactly like 2.1.233. The substantive conclusions (pinned token in preserve-mtime mode, reload in plain mode) still hold on the real 2.1.234, but the report's version attribution and its behavioural claim about 2.1.234 are wrong.
findings.evidence: /tmp/bb-reports/issues/1654/verify/my-which-bin.mjs output: child is .../node_modules/.pnpm/@anthropic-ai+claude-agent-sdk-linux-x64@0.3.197/.../claude; that binary reports '2.1.197 (Claude Code)'; SDK manifest.json version 2.1.197. Report's default log shows 'HEAD /' and 1 call per 429; my run with REPRO_CLAUDE_BIN=~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.234 shows 'HEAD /api/hello' and 11 calls per 429 turn (my-run-preserve-mtime-real-2.1.234.log, my-run-default-real-2.1.234.log; the earlier verifier's run-preserve-mtime-real-2.1.234.log shows the same). bb itself spawns /home/sawyer/.local/bin/claude (ps in my-bb-e2e-pid.txt), so the default repro exercises a different binary than bb does.
findings.fix: State that the SDK's default spawns its bundled CLI (2.1.197 for SDK 0.3.197) and that bb spawns the PATH claude; make step 3/4 pass REPRO_CLAUDE_BIN=$(readlink -f ~/.local/bin/claude) (or have the script default to it) so the repro uses the same binary bb does; relabel/regenerate the two default logs; delete or correct the '2.1.234 single call / no longer retries' statements in excerpts §4 and Related issues (attribute the 1-call behaviour to 2.1.197, and 11 retries to 2.1.233 and 2.1.234).

findings.problem: 'Restarting the bb server fixes it' is marked Verified, but no server restart was actually performed; the evidence is the SDK repro's fresh-process step plus a `bb thread stop` workaround, i.e. an inference that a restart also yields a fresh process.
findings.evidence: Table row cites 'repro Step 4: new process → token B' and 'bb thread stop ... new pid'; the bb-e2e transcript and appendix command list contain no restart of the dev server.
findings.fix: Either mark it 'Verified by proxy (fresh process)' or actually restart the dev instance (`pnpm dev:stop` + `scripts/bb-dev-app current`), resend, and record the new claude pid.

findings.problem: run-preserve-mtime-2.1.233.log and run-all.py exist in repro/ but the report never links them (2.1.233 log is inlined in the appendix without a link; run-all.py is unreferenced), and the text refers to 'run-preserve-mtime-2.1.233.log' by name only.
findings.evidence: grep of href="1654/..." in the HTML lists only 5 of the 7 repro artifacts.
findings.fix: Add relative links for the two remaining artifacts or drop run-all.py.

findings.problem: A few terms are used without a one-line gloss for a reader who knows nothing about the stack: 'SSE reply', 'memoize/memo', 'streaming-input query()', 'settle/emitSessionReplacement'. mtime is explained only implicitly.
findings.evidence: TL;DR paragraph 2 and Root cause item 2.
